title: The Elements / Logotype, Dots and G
slide_intent: Give one identity several forms so it can remain recognizable when space and interaction needs change.
strategic_value: The same four colors can connect Google’s name, compact icon and responsive assistant behavior.
demonstration: A short looping animation aligns the full wordmark, four vertically shifting colored dots and the compact multicolored G on white.
practical_value: Choose between naming the brand, indicating an interaction and fitting a small space by comparing the three forms together.

content_islands.name: Responsive dots
content_islands.spec: Center four animated colored dots between the fixed marks.

content_islands.name: Compact identifier
content_islands.spec: Place the multicolored G at right at a comparable optical scale.

reference_purposes.Intent: The article explains that the dots serve interactive and transitional moments while the G works in small contexts.
reference_purposes.Expression: The three aligned forms share color but differ in structure and movement.
reference_purposes.Application: The accompanying captions assign a different use to each form.

ingredient.name: Three identity states
ingredient.role: Maintain recognition across a name, an interaction and a small icon.
ingredient.application: Use the logotype for the full name, dots for interactive or transitional moments, and G for compact contexts as described by the article.
ingredient.scope: The 2015 identity family; the saved MP4 is a playback conversion of the original short GIF.
